title: Waypoint Curated Domain Library — Root Catalog
description: Top-level index of all curated domain knowledge available to the Waypoint server. Three top-level sections: accommodations (organized by context, profile, cognitive deficit, achievement deficit), modifications (curriculum, assignment, assessment), and measuring-goals (data collection, progress reporting). Use this to discover relevant categories, then load the per-section catalogs and specific files via the get_strategies tool.

sections.title: Accommodations
sections.description: Strategies that change HOW the student accesses content or responds — same learning expectation. Organized in four parallel taxonomies; the same accommodation may appear retrievable through multiple lenses.

subsections.title: Accommodations by Classroom Context
subsections.description: Where the accommodation applies in the school day (environment, transitions, language, peer/social, sensory, behavior, testing, tools, miscellaneous). Source: ADayInOurShoes.com

subsections.title: Accommodations by Disability Profile
subsections.description: Profile-specific lists for Anxiety, Executive Function Disorder, and Nonverbal Learning Disability. Source: ADayInOurShoes.

subsections.title: Accommodations by Cognitive Deficit
subsections.description: Organized by Woodcock-Johnson III cognitive cluster (long-term retrieval, short-term memory, processing speed, auditory processing, visual-spatial, comprehension-knowledge, fluid reasoning). Each file: Definition + Accommodations + Instructional Strategies. Source: Seaman Compendium.

subsections.title: Accommodations by Achievement Deficit
subsections.description: Organized by academic skill area (basic reading, reading comprehension, spelling, basic math, math reasoning, penmanship), plus a research-supported techniques file (SQ4R, Drill Sandwich, Cover-Copy-Compare, etc.). Source: Seaman Compendium Sections Two and Three.

sections.title: Modifications
sections.description: Strategies that change WHAT the student is taught, demonstrates, or is assessed on — different learning expectation than peers. Always check the IEP's Modifications section for authorization before applying.

sections.title: Measuring IEP Goals
sections.description: How to operationalize IEP goal data collection: classroom systems, cadence, methods, scoring conventions, progress-report drafting.

tag_vocabulary.description: Canonical tags used across all curated files for retrieval. Use these strings exactly when filtering with get_strategies(tags).
